display_name: reference_response原Phase1剩余机制：R2至R6共136行：故障恢复r02
description: 修复进程退出竞态后新建独立运行。复用16行已完成、从零训练且未接触目标的R2产物；剩余120行按原矩阵从零训练。预算、源域选择及目标测试计划不变。
authorization: 用户2026-10-06：然后修复问题，继续跑实验。保留每卡两个实验及训练后clean与六residual自动测试授权。

data.representation: equalized=1; center256; unit packet RMS; fs=25000000Hz
data.tx_sets_ref: ManySig.tx_list: all6; actual physical class strings exported at runtime
data.leo_config_ref: native practical_adapter and frozen matched recipe; supervised concat unless row ablates it; separate DAOT/MUSE views as declared

permissions.query_use: frozen Phase1 inference only; separate truth-last scorer
permissions.claim_scope: BENCHMARK_INFORMED_FIXED_DESIGN: user-fixed architecture on exposed benchmark; no fresh blind architecture-selection claim. No test feedback into tuning, selection or selective rerun.

checkpoint.initialization: R2 completed scratch artifact reuse; R3–R6 scratch

sources.role: source selection and frozen evaluation only; never future training initialization

checkpoint.selection_rule: Own E200. Parent mechanism features only, never weights. Each stage fixed4seed mean(.5V+.5worstRX), exactties published arm order; no query until all stages frozen.

execution.gpu_policy: Maximum16 concurrent and2/GPU; >=12GB free before launch; owned child processes, no old-worker adoption
execution.stop_rule: Nonfinite loss/gradient, source or target permission violation, output collision or nonzero exit fails only affected row; no low-performance stop, automatic retry, fallback or unrelated intervention.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: comparison_suite.score:p1 after136 predictions; cvs_phase1_stack.analyze independent bincount recount
metrics_plan.primary: Accuracy/Macro-F1/worstRX mean and sampleSD; fixed stage controls and pairedseed differences; R5 interaction; complete row/view/RX/TX confusion and resource costs
metrics_plan.full_cvs_reference: DAOT+RC4 results descriptive only; its U_s use and optimization-step budget differ
